description: Test file for Telegram channel bindings, including unit tests for functions that normalize conversation IDs, match conversations, and resolve command conversations.

methods.name: normalizeTelegramAcpConversationId
methods.description: Normalizes a Telegram ACP conversation ID, returning IDs if valid, otherwise null.

methods.name: matchTelegramAcpConversation
methods.description: Determines if a conversation matches a canonical format based on conversation IDs.

methods.name: resolveTelegramCommandConversation
methods.description: Resolves a conversation ID based on a command thread and originating target.
